ligand substitution effects, in the case of Cl substitution on the 2-position of qsal−, are not significant on spin crossover properties of the complexes.
the Cl substituent has a significant effect on the packing of the compounds, which in turn affects the spin crossover properties of the compounds.
the introduction of Cl into the qsal− framework has a profound impact on the spin crossover properties.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the introduction of a halogen substituent on the ligand has a profound influence on both structural packing and spin crossover properties of iron(III) spin crossover compounds.
heteroleptic iron(II) and iron(III) spin crossover complexes are more interesting than homoleptic iron(2+) and iron(III).

The main takeaway from our work is that
Cl substitution on the ligand can have significant effects on the spin crossover behavior.
the Cl substitution on the ligand, qsal, is a useful strategy to tune the packing interactions and hence, spin crossover properties of these compounds.
